chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Sama'ah, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding the free man marrying the slave girl, he (peace be upon him) said: There is no problem when he is desperate to her.

key_terms.اضْطُرَّ: He was in need / desperate / compelled
key_terms.الْحُرِّ: The free man (as opposed to a slave)
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: There is no problem / It is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a free man to marry a slave girl in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the permissibility of a free man marrying a slave girl, specifically validating the union when driven by necessity (idtirar) to preserve chastity. In Shia jurisprudence, this ruling is often contextualized within the broader framework of family structure and the distinct legal status of slave women (mawātī) compared to free women, highlighting the practical flexibility of early Imams in addressing social realities.
